lines.text: Esau, also called Edom, took wives including Adah, Oholibamah, and Basemath, who was the daughter of Ishmael.
Esau moved with his household and livestock far from Jacob because the land could not support them, and settled in Mount Carmel.
Timna, a concubine of Eliphaz, gave birth to Amalek.
Anah found the hot springs in the wilderness while pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Edom, reigned among the kings before any king ruled Israel.
